programme.title: Venganza del más allá
programme.desc: Tres adinerados hombres se reúnen para su juego de caza anual en el desierto. Pero esta vez, uno de ellos viene acompañado de su amante Jen, una mujer joven y atractiva que despierta el interés de los otros. programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Emiliano es visitado por Corona y éste le muestra las fotos en que Rosario aparece junto a los cabecillas de la organización. Emiliano no tendrá otra opción que acceder a las pretensiones del abogado. Por otro lado, Rosario recibe la visa mexicana.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El comandante Salas revisa el interrogatorio y empieza a dudar de la culpabilidad de Emiliano. Por otro lado, Rosario no puede entrar al reclusorio por ser Emiliano un preso de alta seguridad. Rosario buscara la ayuda de la teniente Morales.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: El encuentro en la cárcel entre Emiliano y Rosario resulta muy corto, y sirve para confirmar que la pareja se ama igual que antes. No obstante, el mariachi le advierte a su novia que lo mejor para ella es que no se vuelvan a ver.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Rosario regresa a Colombia y es bien recibida por todos sus compañeros. Por otro lado, el doctor Javier Macías le dice a Don Carlos que deben liquidar el bar cuanto antes para poder asumir las deudas que tiene.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Los muchachos de la manada intentan encontrar la forma para salvar el bar Garibaldi y dentro de esta búsqueda Rosario descubre que el culpable de esta crisis financiera es el Doctor Macías. Por otro lado, llega el día del juicio de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Al enterarse de la condena que tendrá que asumir Emiliano por unos crímenes que no cometió, Sigifredo y Fernando le escriben un correo electrónico anónimo al comandante Salas, comentándole que está cometiendo una gran injusticia.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Con dolor en sus corazones, los mariachis del bar Garibaldi se despiden. Rosario vende el traje de su papá para pagar la deuda que tiene con Javier Macías. Por otra parte, el comandante Salas decide reabrir la investigación del caso de Emiliano.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Han transcurrido varios meses desde el cierre del bar Garibaldi. Los integrantes de la manada no la pasan bien en sus nuevas vidas. Por otro lado, el Comandante Salas visita a Emiliano para decirle que ya sabe toda la verdad de su caso.

programme.title: La hija del mariachi
programme.desc: Las autoridades capturan a Miguel Corona y sus socios. Emiliano y Felipe recobran su libertad. Por otra parte, un empresario mexicano reabrirá el bar plaza Garibaldi.

programme.desc: Alejandro Villa Ruiz, el empresario que compró el bar Plaza Garibaldi, reúne a todos los integrantes del grupo de mariachis para hablarles sobre sus contratos. Además el empresario va en busca de don Carlos Malagón para proponerle que sea su socio.

programme.desc: Emiliano aparece por sorpresa vestido de Mariachi y con varias canciones le recuerda a Rosario que ella es la mujer de su vida. Emiliano y Rosario ahora podrán disfrutar de ese sentimiento que por las injusticias de la vida tuvieron que retener.

programme.title: Hermanitas calle
programme.desc: La familia se apellida Calle. Son 4 hermanas, 1 hermano, la mamá, un tío y los novios. Dos de las hermanas son cantantes populares y consiguen un contrato discográfico, pero todos los miembros de la familia, incluyéndolas, atraviesan situaciones dramáticas. Tienen que enfrentar muchos problemas que no dejan de aparecer. Las dos protagonistas son las hermanas cantantes. Además, deben enfrentarse al alcalde corrupto y malvado, quien acusa falsamente a una de ellas y hace que termine en la cárcel.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una sous chef a bordo de un crucero abandona su turno inesperadamente y nunca más vuelve a ser vista. ¿Alguien a bordo la vio antes de que desapareciera? ¿Qué pistas existen sobre su paradero?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un agente inmobiliario de vacaciones en un crucero se enfrenta a más de lo que puede manejar cuando lo descubren muerto en la cubierta. ¿Fue un trágico accidente o alguien tenía una cuenta pendiente con este negociador?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un director de crucero es encontrado muerto en el baño. Todas las señales apuntan a un asesinato mientras los investigadores empiezan a revisar las pruebas para descubrir al perpetrador y llevarlo ante la justicia.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una mujer decide tomar en unas vacaciones en crucero sin informar a su familia. Cuando ésta desaparece, su familia busca respuestas y terminará cambiando la forma en que se informa sobre personas desaparecidas en el mar.

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Una adinerada socialité de San Francisco es asesinada en el mar, golpeada hasta la muerte con una botella de whisky. ¿Podría su mayordomo, que también se alojaba en su habitación, tener alguna pista para resolver este asesinato?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros
programme.desc: Un crucero de reunión de secundaria se vuelve mortal cuando la cerebrito de la clase aparece muerta. ¿Cometió un compañero de clase un terrible acto en su contra? ¿Había alguna cuenta pendiente por saldar?

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros

programme.title: Asesinatos en Cruceros

programme.title: El Arte del Robo
programme.desc: El 22 de diciembre de 2000, tres de los tesoros artísticos más importantes del mundo fueron robados del Museo Nacional de Estocolmo. Un Rembrandt y dos cuadros de Renoir se valoraron en 50 millones de dólares.

programme.title: El Arte del Robo
programme.desc: Fue el mayor atraco al arte en la historia de América. El botín incluía un raro Vermeer y pinturas de Rembrandt y Degas. Desde entonces, equipos de agentes del FBI han trabajado en el caso.

programme.title: El Arte del Robo
programme.desc: Lo más importante en el mercado mundial del arte es si es auténtico o falso. Cuando una falsificación se hace pasar por real, se pueden ganar y perder fortunas. Durante casi una década, dos ingleses hicieron justamente eso. Sus actividades cambiaron literalmente la historia del arte. Fue uno de los mayores fraudes en el mundo del arte. ¿Cómo se salieron con la suya durante tanto tiempo?

programme.title: El Arte del Robo
programme.desc: Hace casi treinta años siete cuadros, incluyendo un valioso Cezanne, fueron robados de una colección privada en América. Con el paso de los años, Michael Bakwin, propietario de los cuadros, pensó que nunca volvería a ver su querido Cezanne.

programme.title: El Arte del Robo
programme.desc: En la década de 1970, el mercado negro de objetos religiosos formó parte de una industria multimillonaria. Así es como una sofisticada red de traficantes arrancó un mosaico sagrado de las paredes de una iglesia.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López se encuentra casualmente con un antiguo amigo que ahora es manager musical. Para recordar los viejos tiempos, éste le propone relanzar su carrera de "rumbero" juvenil.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Marina quiere que David la acompañe a una expedición científica en alta mar. David, no sabe nadar pero se lo calla y se une a la expedición para no desilusionarla.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: "Radio Bofarull" esta a punto de cerrar por falta de audiencia. Ramón tiene una idea para salvarla: escribe un guión radiofónico sobre una fuga en la central nuclear.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David descubre que, para triunfar como actor, se necesita algo más que vocación. Se debe estar muy preparado. Por eso decide apuntarse a todo tipo de cursillos.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Lidia, exnovia de López, regresa embarazada del Amazonas y está a punto de dar a luz. Poco a poco, López se va implicando en los preparativos del parto bajo la mirada crítica de David.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López está emocionadísimo por su recién estrenada paternidad pero Lidia le comunica que se va a Brasil con la niña. David le monta una gran fiesta de despedida. Por fin las cosas regresarán a la normalidad.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Llega al Instituto del Treatro un nuevo profesor extranjero. Sus peculiares métodos crean polémica entre sus alumnos hasta el punto que Pol decide enfrentarse a él. David, en cambio, está encantado con sus clases.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: A López y a David les han embargado el piso por culpa de un crédito que López pidió para su padre y que éste no le devuelve.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David se queda encerrado en el lavabo. Carbonell intenta abrir la puerta pero es imposible; el inquilino anterior montó allí un refugio nuclear.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David toma conciencia de la degradación del medio ambiente y decide hacerse ecologista.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Las familias de López y David han hecho planes para celebrar las fiestas navideñas prescindiendo de ellos. Por ese motivo, los dos deciden pasar de las navidades y fingir que se trata de días normales.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La abuela de David se presenta por sorpresa y asegura que ha notado que está a punto de morirse y quiere que eso ocurra en casa de su nieto.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La abuela Sunción aún vive en otra época. No entiende lo que significa vivir juntos sin estar casados o que dos amigos compartan piso para pagar el alquiler.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Quim Monzó pide a López que le escriba su próxima novela. Nadie debe enterarse. David quiere estrenarse como director de cine y empieza a preparar una película.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López se va de viaje a Cuba y regresa con una cubana. Está decidido a casarse con ella para que obtenga la nacionalidad española pero David se enamora perdidamente de ella. Los dos acabarán peleándose para acompañarla al altar.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Una compañía de teatro alternativo contrata a David como actor. Empiezan a tener problemas cuando les niegan la subvención que habían pedido y no saben de donde sacar el dinero para acabar de montar el espectáculo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López son un par de pesimistas y deciden espabilar a Emma porque creen que vive en un mundo feliz e irreal.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David consigue un papel en una serie de televisión. Su personaje ha sufrido un accidente y está en el hospital, muy enfermo y con el rostro desfigurado.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La vida es sueño y los sueños, sueños son. El capítulo empieza con un sueño de López en el que aparece en situaciones muy inusuales hasta que se da cuenta de que se trata de un sueño.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López regresa a la universidad para conseguir el título de licenciado. Allí comprueba que los estudiantes de ahora no tienen nada que ver con los de su época.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mientras ve una película, David tiene una revelación mística y creer que es Jesucristo. Vestido de Jesucristo, acaba convenciendo a todos sus amigos. Su primer milagro es la multiplicación del donut.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López y David están hartos de vivir juntos y deciden separarse. López se marcha del piso y encuentra otro, más pequeño y más caro.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Ha llegado el verano y todos tienen ganas de ir a la playa a ligar y a ponerse morenos. López y Ramón montan un stand de la radio en la playa pero deciden aparcar el trabajo e irse a ligar en tanga.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Ángel, el guardia urbano de la playa, busca a Emma para devolverle el zapato que perdió en verano y para decirle que la quiere.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La abuela de David no puede dormir, está hiperactiva. El médico que va a visitarla le receta unas "hierbas" de maría. Todos deciden aprovechar la ocasión.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Oriol, el padre de López, se jubila y se instala en casa de los chicos. La alegría de la jubilación le dura poco, en casa se aburre y esto le envejece prematuramente.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Stasky amplia las posibilidades del bar ofreciendo un servicio a domicilio. Emma se ofrece a llevar un pedido al Museo de cera pero, las horas pasan, y no regresa. David y Stasky van a buscarla.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Para librarse de una multa, Emma dice que es la novia de Ángel, el guardia. Pero Ángel se entera de su mentira y decide que va a pagárselas todas juntas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma no sabe como decirle a Ángel que no quiere casarse con él. David y López tampoco creen que el matrimonio funcione. Quieren convencer a Emma de que no se case pero ella les dice que no se preocupen, que todo está controlado.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma y López llevan a Marujito a un concurso de canto de canarios porque están convencidos de que puede convertirse en una gran estrella.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol regresa a Barcelona por unos días y David está muy emocionado. Pero, al reencontrarse, se dan cuenta de que su relación de amistad ya no es como antes.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López conoce a Guillermina en un chat y se enamora. Pero, por culpa de una casualidad, Guillermina confunde a López con David y David decide no sacarla de su error.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Ahora que López y Guillermina son novios, nunca encuentran ni el momento ni el lugar para tener un poco de intimidad.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López tiene planeado un fantástico fin de semana con Guillermina pero todos apuestan que no serán capaces de aguantar tantas horas juntos.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López se quiere casar con Guillermina y se va a Finlandia a pedir los papeles del divorcio a Diana. Allí se despierta algo en su interior a ritmo de salsa.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mientras López está en Finlandia, David y Guillermina se lían. A su regreso, David está muy extraño. Los remordimientos no le dejan vivir.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Josep López es locutor de radio en una emisora local. A sus treinta y cuatro años se da cuenta de que debe independizarse y empieza a buscarse un piso.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López se enteran de que a Emma le dan miedo las películas de terror y deciden aprovecharse. Esa noche, Emma va a quedarse a dormir en su piso y ellos traman un plan para hacer un trío con ella creyendo que ella aceptará a la primera.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Un nuevo becario llega a la radio en la que trabaja López. Es un chico que no acaba de funcionar; López intenta ayudarle pero lo único que consigue es que el chico se aproveche de él.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López quiere celebrar su cumpleaños con una gran fiesta pero David cree que ya es demasiado viejo para esas cosas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol, que está absolutamente convencido de ser homosexual, se enrolla con Emma y supone que no por eso dejará de serlo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Oriol, el padre hippy de López, se presenta en casa de su hijo y decide instalarse unos días. David queda realmente impresionado con Oriol, sería genial tener un padre así.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Ariadna, la hija de Mercedes, se enamora de López, que también queda prendado de ella. David le acusa de infanticida.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David recibe una carta del Ministerio de Defensa conforme debe ir a la mili. David pide a López que le espere y cuando regrese seguirán siendo compañeros de piso.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López queda para cenar con Ramón y con su mujer, Rosa. Durante la cena, Rosa no le dirige la palabra pero, a espaldas de Ramón, le tira los tejos.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol descubre que Emma está enamorada de López y les prepara una cita a través de un anónimo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David descubre que su madre tiene un amante y decide contárselo a su padre pero no sabe por donde empezar.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López alquila una plaza de parking. Él no tiene ni coche ni carnet de conducir pero ese parece un buen sistema para planteárselo en serio e intentar sacárselo.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López se han enamorado de Emma. Ninguno dejará que el otro la vea a solas y saque ventaja. Carbonell intenta vender a todo el mundo un viaje organizado por ella.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell, Ramón, Pol y Mercedes regresan del viaje. Ramón no para de contar que Pol le salvó la vida y que siempre estará en deuda con él.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma se ha ido. López y David están hechos polvo tras su marcha. Al enterarse de que el administrador del bloque busca un nuevo inquilino para la casita de madera, David y López salen desesperadamente en busca de Emma.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y López no saben qué hacer con un paquete de droga que les ha llegado por error. Si lo venden, pueden sacar mucho dinero pero si les pillan... aunque quizás deberían preocuparse por si su dueño lo reclama.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma quiere pedir el paro pero allí la convocan a un cursillo y debe pasar un examen. Carbonell y Mercedes le echarán una mano para que apruebe.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mercedes intenta hablar de un tema importante con López, que la esquiva constantemente por miedo a que le eche una bronca.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Mercedes decide darse un tiempo de reflexión y descanso después de su ruptura sentimental. Se va de la radio y nombra a López nuevo director.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol decide sacar más partido del bar Mauricio y prepara varias actuaciones que sirvan de reclamo para ganar clientes. David prepara una actuación que muestre sus grandes dotes interpretativas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David decide montar una fiesta para celebrar la noche de Halloween. López, mucho más tradicional, prefiere celebrar la castañada.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: La exnovia de López regresa a Barcelona para verle y para proponerle que engendre a su hijo ya que quiere ser madre soltera.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell lleva a casa un gato que pertenece a un "capo" mafioso, al que le debe un favor. Deberá cuidarlo durante el fin de semana.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David está resfriado y decide llamar al médico de la Seguridad Social.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Pol, López y David leen en el periódico que un asesino anda suelto por su barrio.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell conoce a un hombre en una discoteca y empiezan a bailar muy compenetrados.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: El reencuentro entre Oriol y Carbonell desencadena la prisa de López y David por llevar a la pareja hasta el altar, no sin antes celebrar las respectivas despedidas de soltero.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: ¡Qué bonita es la Navidad! El pesebre, el árbol, los regalos, los villancicos, la familia... y las peleas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: En este capítulo se descubre quienes son "realmente" los actores que dan vida a los personajes de la serie. Asistimos a la representación de lo que es una grabación en plató de uno de los capítulos y podemos ver a David haciendo de Joel Joan, a López haciendo de Jordi Sánchez, etc.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Desde que Carbonell se casó y se fue a vivir a Porrera con Oriol, David no da una. Acostumbrado a que se lo hicieran todo, ahora tiene que espabilarse solo y no se le da muy bien.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: López es un desastre como asistenta así que David decide organizar un "casting" para encontrar a alguien que sea competente.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Carbonell se separa de Oriol y regresa al piso de López y David. Éstos descubren casualmente que Oriol es propietario de muchas tierras y fuerzan el divorcio de Carbonell y Oriol a fin de sacar tajada de la ruptura.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David recibe la llamada de un productor convocándole a un casting en Madrid. Él sabe que es una gran oportunidad para su carrera de actor.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: Emma presenta una amiga suya, Lola, a David y éste se queda embobado. Con la ayuda de Carbonell monta una fiesta en el piso para poder invitarla. Por otro lado, a López le cae un "encargo" de sus jefes de la radio: hacer de canguro de su hijo. La fiesta será el punto de encuentro para sorpresa de uno y enfado del otro.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David sale con Lola pero, en realidad, está enamorado de Marina, la amiga de Lola. Por eso, prepara una cena y le pide a López que se líe con Lola, pero éste es un despistado y se pasa toda la noche confundiéndolas.

programme.title: Platos Sucios
programme.desc: David y Marina ya salen juntos y están muy enamorados. Los amigos de David no entienden esta relación (Marina es tan interesante...).

programme.title: Pilotos del Ártico (Ice Pilots)

programme.title: El Precio de la Gloria
programme.desc: Los dos hijos de un matador de toros crecen, siguen la profesión de su padre y se enamoran de la misma mujer.

programme.title: Macho y Hembra
programme.desc: Dos mujeres y un hombre rompieron las reglas en una relacion donde todo está permitido.

programme.title: Patrulla de Valientes
programme.desc: Un ranchero mexicano envía a su hijo para la Guardia Forestal Mexicana tal como sirvió él en su juventud. El hijo se involucra en un escándalo de corrupción con la Guardia de Seguridad de la gobernación, sin dimensionar las consecuencias.

programme.title: El Capitán Mantarraya
programme.desc: El capitán Mantarraya, aventurero y charlatán, se deleita contando sus memorias a un público de inocentes niños. Esta vez compartirá la historia de una mujer que lo contrató para ir a la Isla Maldita.

programme.title: El Caballo Prieto Afamado
programme.desc: Un melodrama ambientado en una zona rural que nos muestra a través de su más afamado y de majestuosa belleza equina, todas las aventuras en el marco de música, jinetes y carreras.

programme.title: El Increíble Profesor Zovek

programme.title: Muñecos Infernales
programme.desc: Cuatro hombres, miembros de una expedición, son maldecidos por un sacerdote vudú por robar un ídolo sagrado de su templo. Pronto, una banda de "muñecos" asesinos persigue a los hombres y sus familias.

programme.title: Las Canciones Unidas
programme.desc: Los delegados a una conferencia internacional deberán decidir sobre un 'Canto Unido', capturando las tradiciones y características culturas de los países participantes. Un muestra de arte sin precedentes!.

programme.title: El Beso de Ultratumba
programme.desc: Un hombre fallece, pero su alma sigue inquieta. El desamor lo lleva a buscar venganza.

programme.title: El Norteño Enamorado
programme.desc: Una ataviada historia que entreteje la opulencia de un hacendado, la codicia y envidia de quien quiere arrebatarle sus propiedades y en medio, las víctimas junto con quienes vienen a exigir justicia.

programme.title: El Conde de Montecristo
programme.desc: Edmundo Dantés es falsamente acusado por los celos de otros por su buena fortuna y es condenado a pasar el resto de su vida en la famosa prisión de la isla, Chateau d'lf. Mientras encarcelado, se encuentra con Abbe Faria, un compañero de prisión a quien todo el mundo cree que estar loco. Abbe Faria le dice a Edmundo de un tesoro fantástico escondido en una pequeña isla que sólo él conoce la ubicación. Después de muchos años de prisión, el viejo Abbe muere y Edmundo escapa disfrazado como el cuerpo. Ahora libre, Edmundo debe encontrar el tesoro de Abbe le contó, para que pueda vengarze de aquellos que lo han hecho mal.

programme.title: Juan Camaney en Acapulco
programme.desc: En el paradisíaco Acapulco, Juan Camaney siente que pierde su encanto. Desesperado, acude a un brujo que le da una pócima para recuperar su vigor y volverse irresistible para las mujeres más bellas, desatando divertidas aventuras.

programme.title: Besos Prohibidos
programme.desc: Daniel le propone matrimonio a Teresa, una hermosa cantante y madre de una niña. Pero ella no es viuda, como él cree: su esposo cumple una condena de 30 años en prisión. Ahora, Teresa deberá decidir su futuro.

programme.title: El Chismoso de la Ventana
programme.desc: Las cómicas aventuras de Godinez y Antógenes y todas las maldades a las que sometían al empleado de su tienda de antigüedades. Pronto llegará a sus manos un artículo que subirá la picardía en la tienda.

programme.title: La Maldición de la Momia Azteca
programme.desc: El malvado Dr. Krupp, una vez más tratando de apoderarse de las joyas de la princesa azteca de Xochitl, hipnotiza a su reencarnación actual, Flor, para que ella revela la ubicación de las joyas "- la tumba de Xochitl. Confusión reina cuando Krupp y sus matones se oponen por el amante de Flor, el Dr. Almada, su asistente, y superhéroe lucha libre, El Ángel. Krupp, finalmente se encuentra con su partido, sin embargo, cuando se enfrenta a Popoca, el guerrero de la momia que guarda la tumba de Xochitl.

programme.title: Móvil Pasional
programme.desc: El comisario Gyula investiga la muerte de un empresario estadounidense. La principal sospechosa es su viuda, una exprostituta, y heredera de su fortuna. Para resolver el caso Gyula debe profundizar en las áreas más sórdidas y violentas de Caracas.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Vania le propone matrimonio a Larisa, pero Sima no la aprueba. Irina manipula a Vania para que reclame su parte de la granja. Sima conoce a un editor llamado Andréi en un viaje.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Andréi se enamora de Sima, pero ella lo rechaza. Vania y Larisa se mudan a la ciudad. Larisa lo abandona, dejándole a su hijo. Irina es amenazada por delincuentes por ayudar a Vania.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Vania e Irina son secuestrados por criminales. Sima y Andréi intentan rescatarlos. Irina se arrepiente de su pasado y pide perdón. Los prisioneros intentan escapar.

programme.title: Serafima la bella
programme.desc: Víctor muere e Irina culpa a Sima. Irina intenta llevarse a su hija, pero Sima sigue adelante con la ayuda de la niña y de su ahijada. Vania, el hijo de Sima, regresa del ejército y se enamora de una empleada de Irina.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Marina vive una vida ordinaria: trabaja como cajera en un banco y tiene una relación con su colega. Quiere aventura, peligro y emoción, pero cada día es como otro, y no le ocurre nada interesante... Hasta que unos enmascarados toman el banco, y Marina, entre los demás empleados, es tomada como rehén. Se enamora del cabecilla, aunque no pueda ver su rostro bajo la máscara.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Galia enfrenta la enfermedad terminal de su hijo Pavlik, quien necesita un costoso tratamiento en EE.UU. Mientras tanto, su distracción permite que una clienta robe en la tienda donde trabaja, lo que la pone en la mira de la policía. Por otro lado, Misha y Kolia inician su negocio de ropa ilegal, pero Kolia pierde las primeras ganancias.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha descubre cuánto necesita para el tratamiento de su hijo y decide expandir su negocio ilegal. Junto con Kolia, establece un taller de costura clandestino, pero un vecino intenta sabotearlos. Mientras avanzan en su venta de trajes de baño, la policía empieza a sospechar de sus actividades.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha y Kolia consiguen más tela con ayuda de Grigori, pero necesitan evitar levantar sospechas. Kolia obtiene una firma clave seduciendo a una secretaria. Mientras su negocio crece, un arresto inesperado pone en peligro toda la operación.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Marina vive una vida ordinaria: trabaja como cajera en un banco y tiene una relación con su colega. Quiere aventura, peligro y emoción, pero cada día es como otro, y no le ocurre nada interesante... Hasta que unos enmascarados toman el banco, y Marina, entre los demás empleados, es tomada como rehén. Se enamora del cabecilla, aunque no pueda ver su rostro bajo la máscara.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Galia enfrenta la enfermedad terminal de su hijo Pavlik, quien necesita un costoso tratamiento en EE.UU. Mientras tanto, su distracción permite que una clienta robe en la tienda donde trabaja, lo que la pone en la mira de la policía. Por otro lado, Misha y Kolia inician su negocio de ropa ilegal, pero Kolia pierde las primeras ganancias.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha y Kolya intentan recuperar el dinero que Pan les quitó, pero se enfrentan a un peligroso criminal. Mientras tanto, la salud de Pavlik empeora e Igor es reinstalado en su cargo para investigar el caso del "Francés".

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Durante Año Nuevo, Misha y Igor debaten sobre la moralidad de los criminales. Igor se acerca peligrosamente a descubrir la verdad sobre Kolya, quien logra escapar tras atacarlo, creyendo haberlo matado.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha descubre que Pavlik no es su hijo biológico y su solicitud de visa es rechazada. Kolya es víctima de un chantaje, mientras que Igor encuentra evidencia de los negocios ilícitos de Misha. Como represalia, los hombres de Pan secuestran a Margarita.

programme.title: Jugar con fuego
programme.desc: Misha engaña a Pan para salvar a Margarita y huye con su familia a un pueblo. Al empeorar Pavlik, deciden robar un avión para llegar a EE.UU., pero Misha es arrestado. Gracias al testimonio de Rita, queda libre, aunque ahora han sido delatados a las autoridades.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Roger, lleva a Camila a un edificio en construcción, solitario, bajo coacción la hace hablar con Ezequiel, quien amenaza a Roger con matarlo si llega a dañar a Camila. Roger expresa todo el odio cómo fue que asesinó a su hermano Marcos. Max y Torrealba llegan y encuentran a Roger descontrolado, con Camila de rehén.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Familiares y amigos presentes en la celebración. Impacta Camila, preciosa y deslumbrante y Ezequiel la presenta como la futura señora López Méndez, pero ésta no puede responder ante sorpresivos disparos que hieren a Ezequiel. Marcelina culpable del hecho, aclara que los disparos no eran para Ezequiel, sino para matar a Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: El detective Torrealba presiona a Marcelina; Max trata de convencerlo de que su madre está enferma y no es responsable de sus actos. Camila es detenida para ser interrogada y contesta que no desea hacer cargos contra Marcelina y su único deseo es vivir en paz y ser feliz.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Max viene a sacar a Camila de la policía, ella, le agradece el gesto pero se mantiene negada a revelarle sus planes. La Madre Isabel encuentra reunidas a las tres mujeres y sospecha que planean matar a Camila. Comenzando su plan Camila convence a Max y Marcelina de dejar atrás el pasado.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila visita a Marcelina. Ante ella y Max le dice que fue Rosa, su madre, quien la hizo cambiar de parecer, y no presentarán cargos en su contra. Max le pide que se casen pero ella lo sorprende al decirle que ya no lo ama. Max propone a Astrid una relación formal para olvidarse para siempre de Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Como parte de su plan Camila ha cambiado, tanto física como de actitud. Así se presenta ante todos. Max y Astrid continúan su romance; sin embargo, no cesa de recordar a Camila deseando saber todas las verdades que Astrid y Marcelina ocultan.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Solamente la Madre Isabel es convencida de la noble actitud de su muchacha que desistió de las intenciones de cobrar la traición de las tres mujeres y hasta les pidió perdón. Ezequiel cuenta a Camila lo del compromiso de su hijo y ésta le reprocha a que fuera tan rápido, olvidando el gran amor que decía tenerle.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Fausto con doble intención invita a Camila a cenar en su casa para que se relacione con su nueva familia. Ezequiel insiste en hablarle de romance y sentimientos y la joven le recuerda que no fue eso lo que pactaron. Marcelina visita a Ezequiel en el hospital y éste aprovecha para amenazarla si vuelve a intentar hacerle daño a Camila.

programme.title: Piel Salvaje
programme.desc: Camila está alerta sobre la evidente hipocresía de Fausto y Patricia, sin embargo, logra salir airosa de las incesantes preguntas manteniéndose firme en su estrategia de traer la paz a las dos familias. Inconvenientes, con Roger y con Gregorio se los cuenta a Ezequiel que le promete que podrá cobrarse todo lo que le han hecho.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil delves into a tragic story that spanned several decades, shattered lives and left one person behind bars. Fourteen children were held captive by a man who called himself The Messiah … a man who was also their father. Jeanne says she was raised in this environment, which the authorities called cult-like, and that she and her siblings were starved, beaten and had no schooling. In a tear-jerking revelation, Jeanne tells Dr. Phil that she was forced to perform unthinkable sexual acts with her own father, beginning when she was just 5 years old and ending when she was 27. Jeanne may be a victim of horrible cruelty, but her sisters, Miriam and Sarah, say they can’t forgive her for the pain she caused them. Find out why these siblings are estranged, and why Sarah says she’s nervous just sitting next to Jeanne on Dr. Phil’s stage. It’s been 20 years since Jeanne’s father was arrested, but she and her family say the effects of abuse still linger. Can these siblings ever get closure on their horrific past?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two families desperate to find their missing children ask Dr. Phil for help. Two-year-old Bianca disappeared while in the care of her father. He says she was taken when he was carjacked. Was he involved in her disappearance? And, Josh hasn’t seen his son, Trenton, since he was 2 years old, more than five years ago. Did the boy's mother, who died by suicide, take clues with her to the grave?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Mike and Vicki say their 37-year-old son, Ryan, was once making millions running a successful real estate company, but for the past three months, he has been living in their garage, on their dime, along with his 24-year-old girlfriend, Rachel. The parents claim Ryan is a “freeloader” who sleeps all day, acts entitled, picks fights and even leaves them to care for his 5-year-old son. Ryan admits things are chaotic in his life but insists it’s not all his fault. Why does he say his parents are partly to blame for his business failing? Dr. Phil has some tough questions for Ryan about his behavior -- does he take any accountability? And, hear from Rachel -- is she happy with their living situation? Plus, Ryan isn’t the only one staying with mom and dad -- you won’t believe how many mouths Mike and Vicki say they are feeding! How can the parents stop the bleeding and take back control of their lives? And, is Ryan ready to step up to the plate and work toward living on his own?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What would you do if you were standing at the altar in your wedding gown, holding a bridal bouquet in a room full of family and friends ... and the groom didn’t show up? Would you seek revenge? That’s what Dr. Phil’s first guest, Dee, says she did. She says she spent over $31,000 on her special day only to be dumped by her then-fiancé, Danny. He says there’s more to the story than meets the eye. Dee and Danny haven’t seen each other in more than two years. Find out what happens when they face off on Dr. Phil’s stage and what Dee says she did to get even! And, Laurel says that while her ex-boyfriend, Brad Womack, was living life on TV as “The Bachelor,” he continued to send her text messages asking her to marry him. Brad has denied her claims in print, but Laurel says she wants to set the record straight. Plus, Dr. Phil checks back in with Marilyn, who says her fiancé left her with a big bill just six days before the wedding. When Marilyn first appeared on the show, she feared that she would never be able to trust men again. See her amazing update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Did you know that close to 14 million adults still live at home with their parents? Dr. Phil’s first guest is 30 years old, has 2 kids, and is still living with her mom! Her mom wants her out, so why won’t she leave? Then, meet one mother who made her son sign a contract to move out for good. The deadline has lapsed, but he won’t budge. How far will Dr. Phil go to push him out of the nest? Plus, meet a couple who opened their home to 21 family members over the last 7 years. Finally, their nephew came to stay for a couple of days…and two years later he’s still there!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there such a thing as a forgivable lie? Today Dr. Phil talks to couples about working through the damage lies can cause in relationships. One woman says her husband lies so much that she’s ready for divorce. Also, this mom’s been divorced for two years and still hasn’t told her children. Is she living a lie? Plus, Dr. Phil tells you how to spot when your partner is deceiving you.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Christina, who emailed him desperate for help for her daughter, Tara, who she says can be an angry monster. Christina left the home when Tara was 13 years old, but now, she says she's worried that her daughter is in a toxic situation with the ex-husband she calls narcissistic and his 22-year-old new wife who is 20 weeks pregnant. Today, meet the new wife and find out if Dr. Phil can help this chaotic triangle.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obesity is a huge problem for adults in this country, but now it’s becoming an epidemic among children as young as 3 years old. Barbra says her 3-year-old daughter started gaining weight at six months old and now weighs 80 pounds. Barbra and her aunt, Dana, are baffled by what they believe is a medical mystery because they say the little girl doesn't overeat. Dr. Phil brings in two medical experts to get to the bottom of this issue. Is Barbra contributing to her child's weight gain? Then, Tammy says she can’t change her family's eating habits. She's obese, her 11-year-old is 175 pounds and her 9-year-old is 136 pounds. Her sister, Debbie, says the boys portion sizes are too big and the family is just lazy. Can Dr. Phil get Tammy to stick to a nutrition plan? You won’t believe the surprise he has for her! Plus, Jessica says her mom, Angie, is blind to the health issues of her 351-pound sister, Jaleisa, who is only 15. Angie says her mom never buys healthy food, and fears she has Munchausen’s syndrome. Angie says she can’t monitor Jaleisa’s eating habits all day. Can Angie turn this situation around and save her daughter’s life, or is it too late?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's a story that captured the nation: Warren Jeffs, the leader of the Fundamentalist Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-Day Saints (FLDS) and self-proclaimed prophet, was one of the FBI's 10 Most Wanted Fugitives for unlawful flight, sexual conduct with a minor and conspiracy to conduct sexual conduct with a minor. Captured in 2006, Jeffs was recently convicted of sexually assaulting children and sentenced to life, plus 20 years in prison. With an estimated 10,000 followers in his polygamous sect, what will become of Warren Jeffs' victims?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with Jamie, a fitness model who admits he has struggled with drug and alcohol addiction for years. Jamie’s brother, Anthony, says their parents have enabled Jamie at every turn -- including failing to acknowledge Jamie’s other serious problem, which he refuses to discuss. After storming off stage, Jamie rejoins the conversation. Is he ready to be completely honest with his family -- and with himself? Dr. Phil has a sobering wake-up call for Jamie -- and for his parents. Will Jamie finally get the help he needs to get clean -- and stay clean for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you worry your teen daughter could throw away everything she's worked for - all for young love? Dina says she gave her daughter, Sammie, everything she'd ever wanted, but the 19-year-old is now only interested in one thing: her 20-year-old boyfriend, Chris, who has a criminal record. Despite cutting the teen off financially, Dina says her ultimatums fell flat and fears they may only have pushed Sammie further into the arms of a boyfriend she thinks is bad news and may be dangerous. Sammie says her controlling mother and sheltered upbringing are the real problems - but, can she explain the bruises on her body? Then, Samantha is a teen who was blinded by her love affair with her allegedly abusive boyfriend, Aaron. Don't miss her update and somber words for Sammie, whom she fears may be walking blindly down the perilous path she says she knows too well.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: You’ve seen the headlines about student athletes being accused of sexual assaults and other egregious acts -- but are athletes being supported and protected by universities? Dr. Phil meets two women who claim they were sexually assaulted by college athletes and say there is a big double standard when it comes to athletes accused versus typical students. Bailey claims she was sexually assaulted by three basketball players but claims they were protected by the university. Then, Teresa says she knows firsthand the double standard when it comes to athletic preferential treatment because, even though the person who assaulted her was convicted, served time, and had to register as a sex offender, he was allowed to return to the field and was hailed as a star for another university. Plus, when an attorney claims athletes are the victims and their notoriety makes them easy targets for false accusations, he sparks an emotional debate.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Would you risk breaking the law for your children’s education? What about for their safety? Kelley, a single mom, made headlines when she was prosecuted, convicted and sent to jail for listing her father’s address as her daughters’ residence, so they could attend a better school in a safer neighborhood. Kelley says she was working during the day and going to school at night, and after her house was burglarized, she wanted her children in a safer neighborhood for afterschool care. Kelley was convicted of two felony counts for tampering with government documents and spent nine days in jail. Did her punishment fit the crime? And, what other lies did she get caught in? Joining the discussion are Reverend Al Sharpton, columnist Bob Dyer, attorney David Singleton and a fellow single mom in the same school district.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his exclusive jailhouse interview with Kelli Stapleton, a mother accused of trying to kill herself and her severely autistic 14-year-old daughter, Issy. Were there any warning signs that she was reaching her breaking point? And, find out how you can help Issy secure a healthy and productive future.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with some opinionated guests! Can he get them to see that their opinions and judgments can be hurtful?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The mother/daughter relationship can take many forms: best friends, parent-child, and in the case of today’s guests, adversaries. You’ll meet one mom who’s driving her daughter crazy with constant phone calls and unexpected visits. Are her actions creating the separation she fears most? Find out how another mom’s money mismanagement has her daughter feeling both financially and emotionally at risk. Moms, daughters and trust - on the next Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: YouTube sensation “Homeless Joe,” 26, survives on the mean streets of Manhattan by panhandling during the day and picking up women at night. Joe admits he could get a place of his own if he stopped drinking but says being homeless without alcohol is unbearable. Is this “cardboard Casanova” interested in turning his life around?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie says her dad, John, is in “total denial” about being an absolutely terrible hoarder. She says every room in the house is piled to the ceiling with “junk,” including the garage, where she claims she once found a “mummified kitten!” To top it off, Laurie claims the downstairs has a horrible bed bug infestation! John says his daughter is just as big of a mess as he is, has destroyed her room, and absolutely refuses to help him clear out the mess. But the junk-filled house is only the surface level of the toxicity in this home. Laurie’s ex-fiancé, Billy, also lives in the house! Laurie claims Billy is constantly getting “blackout drunk” and getting in fights with her and her father. Can Dr. Phil get to the root of the dysfunction in this home and start to clean up this mess? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s been three years since Glenn Lemoine’s body was found floating in a canal, and his death remains a mystery. His family wants answers -- and they’re pointing the finger at each other. Two agree to take polygraph tests -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Just one day off heroin, Sarah is monitored medically as she goes through painful withdrawal symptoms. Tecoa has been clean for two weeks, but struggles with her own drug cravings while six months pregnant and providing support for her detoxing sibling. Is she sabotaging Dr. Phil's efforts to get Sarah healthy? Dr. Phil shows Sarah and Tecoa a terrifying look into their future. Is it enough to scare them straight?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, made headlines and were the subject of a Lifetime movie called Baby Brokers. The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? Sandy claims her biological parents “sold her like a piece of furniture for $5,000.” Find out what happens when Sandy meets her biological father for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s a case that has grabbed national headlines and rattled a tight-knit Ohio community: Two high school football players are accused of raping a 16-year-old girl while partying last August, and many community members are calling the investigation a cover-up. Are city leaders trying to protect the town’s beloved football program, or is justice being served?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are you living way beyond your means? Do you shop for one pair of shoes, but come home with 10? Do you look great on the outside, while secretly facing financial ruin? Dr. Phil has advice for putting down the checkbook.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ask any teenager, and he or she will tell you how tough life is: schoolwork, dating and dealing with pushy parents. But imagine having two kids while you're still in high school. Dr. Phil sits down with Corey and Kim, a troubled young couple, to see if their relationship can be saved.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nikol says her husband of eight years, Mark, is arrogant, narcissistic, racist and homophobic. She says he belittles and humiliates her and has hit her -- a claim Mark denies. Nikol says some of Mark's outrageous behavior includes urinating on a woman, exposing himself to other men and driving drunk. She also believes that he's cheated on her and fathered children with other women -- but despite all of this, Nikol says she wants to stay with him! Mark claims he's only had emotional affairs, but admits to being a lousy partner and acting outrageously when he's drunk. He says even he wouldn’t want himself as a husband. Can Dr. Phil help break through Mark's tough exterior? When he digs into this couple’s past, he uncovers two troubled childhoods fraught with hardships and abuse. Can their marriage be saved, or are they better off apart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many women are itching to run to the altar, but Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re ready to run for the hills! Kelly is a self-proclaimed runaway bride. She’s been engaged four times but says she gets cold feet before she makes it down the aisle. Rick, her current fiancé, proposed four years ago and is still waiting for her to set a wedding date. Kelly believes that most marriages end in divorce, and she doesn’t want to become another statistic. Should Rick wait for her to make up her mind, or should he cut his losses and move on? Then, Chad and Candi have been engaged for over five years and have two daughters, but Chad says he’s not ready to tie the knot. He says weddings are too expensive, but Candi says he racked up $49,000 in loans for a car, a camper and a new deck for the house. Will Chad break down and give his fiancée the wedding of her dreams? Plus, Dr. Phil talks to a woman who says her fiancé left her six days before the wedding and stuck her with a $150,000 bill -- an allegation he totally denies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The exclusive interview with the Ukrainian orphan who is making headlines. Is she the real life version of “The Orphan”? Natalia’s adoptive parents have been accused of abandoning her when she was just 8 years old. But they claim Natalia, who has a form of dwarfism, is really a sociopathic adult posing as a child -- who tried to kill them. Natalia speaks out for the first time to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What do you do when life’s problems seem so overwhelming that it feels like there’s no way out? Kenny, who was one of the first responders to the 9/11 tragedy, says he still struggles with post-traumatic stress disorder and other health challenges. His wife, Cyndi, and daughter, Gina, say he just sits on the couch and obsesses about that fateful day, and they feel he needs to get over it. Can Kenny get his life and his health back? Then, Steve and Jacki have been married for four years, and Steve says he’s at a crossroads in his relationship. He says his wife puts him last and moved her elderly parents into their home while he was on the road. Jacki says she can’t get over her husband’s insensitivity to her dying mother, and isn’t sure if their relationship can be saved. Is it time for Steve to say enough is enough and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jason and Brandy have been married less than a year, but they say the honeymoon is definitely over! His lying and flirting with other women has her addicted to snooping on him. Will they make it to their first anniversary or should they call it quits? Then, they've only been married for eight months, but Michael says his wife's violent temper is making his life a living hell. Dr. Phil shows them how to fight fair. Plus, a guest who's terrified of getting divorced … and he's not even married yet! Will he ever be ready to pop the question to his girlfriend?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Laurie-Ann emailed Dr. Phil claiming she was robbed by her dangerous, narcissist ex-boyfriend and his new fiancée, Alison. She claims her ex, Michael, held her hostage for seven years. Laurie-Ann claims Michael and Alison are retaliating against her for breaking her silence and filing charges against Michael for domestic violence, emotional abuse, theft, and fraud. But Michael and Alison say Laurie-Ann is a liar who is always playing the victim. Michael says he never held her hostage; she only started to say that because he dumped her. Alison says she just wants Laurie-Ann to move on with her life, let them be happy, and stop stalking them. But Laurie-Ann says Alison doesn’t know how vindictive Michael really is and she claims he has turned everyone, including the police, against her. Laurie-Ann says she wants Dr. Phil to validate her story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What happens when an unhealthy teen relationship threatens to tear a mother and daughter apart? Giesel says her 18-year-old daughter, Devynn, is obsessed with her boyfriend and is damaging a once promising future. Watch the drama unfold as a pregnancy scare rocks this teen's life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: This is one powerful episode you can’t miss! Join us as Dr. Phil gives out-of-control mothers the tools they need to curb their offensive behavior. Learn how one single mother’s yelling and offensive language are driving away her teenage kids. Plus, one woman gave up a career to be a stay-at-home mom. Now regret and anxiety have taken over to create a potentially dangerous situation for her children. Whether dealing with teenagers or toddlers, every parent knows that unrelated stress can lead to unwanted outbursts. Learn through these courageous moms how you can be a better parent.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cindy and Jim say they are fed up with their 35-year-old son, Brandon. They say he’s a moocher who refuses to get job, wears superhero costumes on a daily basis, and has caused $15,000 in damages to their property. Brandon says his parents don’t understand how his mind works. He admits to wearing superhero costumes and going on nightly “Batman” vigilante missions. Brandon says he also created a rapper persona named “Ceeza Caprice” and considers himself a “God MC” who can rap to any beat. Brandon’s sister, Harmony, says she blames her parents for Brandon’s behavior. She says they enable Brandon. She claims Brandon is a manipulator who sees it as a challenge to live off others.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When Sheena Morris was found hanged in a Florida hotel room on New Year's Day 2009, her death was ruled a suicide. But the 22-year-old's parents, Kelly and David, say they believe their daughter was murdered, and have since been working relentlessly to reopen the investigation into her death, which is now under review. On Dr. Phil's stage, they come face to face with the man they believe killed Sheena -- her 48-year-old fiancé, Joe. Were there clues missed in the original investigation? Then, Joe says he believed Sheena was suicidal in the days leading up to her death -- so why did he leave her alone in the hotel room after a heated argument? Does his story add up? Joe takes a polygraph to prove his innocence. Don't miss the shocking results!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Pat, his wife Sarah and his father John, who Pat claims is delusional, paranoid and a threat to his family. John, on the other hand, says he is convinced that Pat and Sarah are a threat to his and his wife’s lives. Pat and Sarah say they want a relationship but claim every attempt is misconstrued by John as some form of life-threatening conspiracy theory. Can Dr. Phil help this family reunite and patch their volatile relationship? And, Pat Smith, wife of retired Dallas Cowboys running back Emmitt Smith, joins Dr. Phil to discuss her new book, Second Chances. In this very intimate publication, Pat shares her journey from loss to redemption, her setbacks and recoveries, and how to let go of what’s holding you back, reinvent your life and rediscover purpose and joy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Dr. Phil exclusive. A beautiful teen goes missing on spring break. Now, 7 years later, shocking new allegations – was Brittanee kidnapped, killed, and thrown into a gator pit? Her family gives their first interview since hearing the nightmarish details about what a jailhouse informant claims happened to their daughter. Plus, hear what a surprising guest has to say – do they know something about Brittanee’s murder?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates what he believes is a problematic phenomenon in our society: Cancel Culture: the way a large group of people can turn on and seek to dismantle the character, career, and sometimes life, of a person who says or does something that doesn't align with the group world view. Dr. Phil welcomes DailyMail.com editor-at-large Piers Morgan, whose new book Wake Up examines this very topic. Dr. Phil also invites Antifa member Daryle, and housewife turned activist Gina, who believes cancel culture is sometimes the only way to bring bigoted people to justice. Watch while Dr. Phil weighs in on this fierce debate!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a man in your life who stomps his feet, pouts, whines and acts like a toddler? A bride-to-be is dealing with an immature fiance and a meddling mother-in-law, and a mooching groom is living in his mom's basement with his common-law wife and baby. Today's guests are grown men whose loved ones want them to grow up!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parent alert: If you have a teenager, watch this show with him or her. Dr. Phil takes a close look at the harsh reality of young girls and boys having a baby while they're still just a baby themselves. It doesn't just happen to the bad girl down the street; your child can become pregnant while living under your roof.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: They don't pay attention! They talk back! And they absolutely lose control when they have temper tantrums! Dr. Phil's talking about toddlers and their top three behavior problems. Find out how you can deal with them.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Sarah and Tecoa's mother, Cindy, sits down with Dr. Phil to answer some hard questions about how her daughters' lives have spun so out of control. Dr. Phil shows her some of the video footage of Sarah's life on the street, selling her body, smoking crack cocaine and shooting heroin, while Tecoa explains how it all began. In a race against time, Dr. Phil gets the sisters off the streets and into The Dr. Phil House. Will Sarah and Tecoa commit to rehab and stay clean?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there such a thing as a forgivable lie? Today Dr. Phil talks to couples about working through the damage lies can cause in relationships. One woman says her husband lies so much that she’s ready for divorce. Also, this mom’s been divorced for two years and still hasn’t told her children. Is she living a lie? Plus, Dr. Phil tells you how to spot when your partner is deceiving you.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Josh says he has very specific and high demands for his future wife, Rebecca, whom he has been dating for over two years, and he says she is not ready to walk down the aisle yet. Josh says he’s a traditional man who brings home the bacon and expects Rebecca to keep a spotless home, take care of the children, and put supper on the table when he gets home from work. Rebecca says Josh is too controlling and feels nothing she ever does is good enough for him. Rebecca says she wants Dr. Phil to fix their relationship, but Josh says he wants to tell her something that he’s been holding in -- and says he fears she’s not going to be happy about what he has to say.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues speaking with a family who claims they were torn apart because of an organization that professes love. Amy says she is “Mother God” and can heal the world with her group, Love Has Won. Her sister Chelsea does not think Amy is a deity, but alleges that she is a brainwashed “cult leader” who abandoned her family years ago and is putting other people’s lives at risk.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Christina and Jim are divorced, and their 21-year-old daughter, Tara, is living with her dad and his new wife who just happens to be the same age as Tara. Christina claims Jim was a horrible husband and a narcissist and she was forced to walk away from the family when Tara was just 13. Since then, she says Jim has let Tara get away with anything and now even allows her to work as a webcam model in order to help pay the bills! She says he is turning their daughter into a raging, angry monster with low self-esteem.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When 24-year-old Andee last met with Dr. Phil, she was struggling with drug addiction -- and her parents, Pam and Ed, blamed each other. After the taping, Andee says she completed 90 days of rehab but later relapsed and is now worse than ever. Is she finally ready to commit to staying clean?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A family says their relative is a cult leader who calls herself "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sex is supposed to be a healthy, normal, natural intimacy that couples share. So why does it threaten to destroy these guests' relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nikol says her husband of eight years, Mark, is arrogant, narcissistic, racist and homophobic. She says he belittles and humiliates her and has hit her -- a claim Mark denies. Nikol says some of Mark's outrageous behavior includes urinating on a woman, exposing himself to other men and driving drunk. She also believes that he's cheated on her and fathered children with other women -- but despite all of this, Nikol says she wants to stay with him! Mark claims he's only had emotional affairs, but admits to being a lousy partner and acting outrageously when he's drunk. He says even he wouldn’t want himself as a husband. Can Dr. Phil help break through Mark's tough exterior? When he digs into this couple’s past, he uncovers two troubled childhoods fraught with hardships and abuse. Can their marriage be saved, or are they better off apart?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Aja says she is sick and tired of taking care of her ungrateful, entitled, drug-addicted mother, Janet. Aja says she has allowed her mom to live with her for eight of the 10 years of her marriage. Aja claims she’s spent $100,000 taking care of her mom and that she does absolutely everything for her without any appreciation. Janet rejects Aja’s claim that she is somehow taking advantage of Aja. She says she pays rent, regularly goes to Narcotics Anonymous, so what else does Aja want from her? Aja says she’s glad her mom has made improvements, but it doesn’t make up for her and her older sister, Ashley’s, neglected childhood. Aja claims they were put in constant danger and surrounded by violent criminals and firearms. But Janet says, “I think my past drug addiction has made my girls the women they are today.” Will Aja finally give her mother the boot? Can this family possibly come together after years of animosity? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is addressing what he feels is a red alert crisis in America: drug and alcohol addiction, which affects 28 million addicts. Over the past 16 seasons, Dr. Phil has been able to help nearly 500 guests with inpatient treatment for substance abuse. Today, he will update some of their amazing recovery stories in hopes that they might inspire others who are struggling with addiction. Find out what happened to three sisters, Valeen, Amanda, and Tiffany, who were not only dangerously addicted to heroin, but also using it together every day. And what happen to Niki, who appeared on the show addicted, homeless, and pregnant? Niki returns to give her shocking update. Bethany said not even a medically induced coma and open heart surgery could get her to stop her dangerous heroin addiction -- find out how she’s doing now. Plus, numerous past guests and their families return to the Dr. Phil stage to share their amazing stories of recovery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In September 2010, 24-year-old Michelle O’Connell was found shot to death in what authorities ruled a suicide -- a case that was recently ordered reopened by the governor of Florida. Michelle’s mother, Patricia, and sister, Jennifer, insist the young mother never would have taken her own life, and they believe Michelle’s boyfriend, Jeremy -- a sheriff’s deputy -- killed her, which he denies. Michelle’s brother, Scott -- also a sheriff’s deputy -- supports Jeremy and says his mother and sister need to stop living in denial. How does he answer his mother’s accusation that he’s betraying his family to save his job? Dr. Phil brings this fractured family together in search of answers. What happened to Michelle that night? Hear from one of the first responders on the scene -- why does she believe the initial finding of suicide was wrong? Plus, can this family put their differences aside and come together and grieve for Michelle?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part one, amid claims of drinking and doing drugs with teenagers and extramarital affairs, Dr. Phil revealed that Lauren’s father, John, had been dubbed the “Breast Pump Bandit” by his city’s local news, for stealing thousands of dollars’ worth of breast pumps and selling them online --and admitted to taking Lauren on some of his shoplifting heists. Today, John admits that he’s addicted to Xanax and crack cocaine, and to stealing from Lauren’s mother to support his habit. Lauren says she wants her mom to kick him out of their lives once and for all. How does Laura respond? It’s a shocking conclusion you don’t want to miss!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Obsessed! First, meet a group of women who can’t get enough of a new craze called reborning -- crafting infant dolls that are so life-like, people mistake them for real babies. Some spend thousands of dollars on their dolls, as if they were real children. Author and comedienne Stefanie Wilder-Taylor spends some time with the doting doll lovers during a party you have to see to believe. Then, Anona says she’s obsessed with her hair, which she hasn’t cut in 17 years. Anona says she’s ready for a change, but how will she react when actress Vivica A. Fox and celebrity stylist Phillip Bloch get their hands on her? Don’t miss this amazing makeover! Plus, a mom is concerned over her 7-year-old’s obsession with all things Elvis. And, Vivica A. Fox spills the beans about an obsession she shares with Dr. Phil’s wife, Robin … that even Dr. Phil wasn’t aware of!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former teacher Tanya Ramirez pled guilty for crossing a forbidden line… having sex with a 17-year-old student who attended the school where she taught, and now, she’s done something many find even more unbelievable, she’s suing him and his mother. After pleading guilty to this charge, Ramirez filed a lawsuit against the teen accusing him of “extreme and outrageous” conduct and invasion of privacy for recording their late-night rendezvous. Ramirez claims the teen showed the tape around school for bragging rights. Ramirez says the sex was consensual, and says the student is an adult and he was just fine after the encounter. Teacher and student face off on Dr. Phil’s stage for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In August 2009, Penny’s 40-year-old sister, Shannon, a successful businesswoman, was found dead in her car, at the bottom of a cliff, in what authorities initially believed was a tragic accident but later ruled a homicide -- a case that remains unsolved. Emotions run high when Penny faces her father, Ted, for the first time in two years and drops a bombshell: She believes he hired a hitman to kill Shannon. Ted admits his relationship with Shannon was strained at the time, but he vehemently denies he had anything to do with her death. How will Ted react to Penny’s accusation? Tune in to watch the drama unfold as this father and daughter angrily level charges against each other -- can Penny and Ted find a way to repair their relationship, or have the accusations gone too far?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The nation was captivated in 2009 when Susan Powell, a beautiful loving mother of two, vanished without a trace. Her husband, Josh, was considered a person of interest but was never charged with a crime. His account of what happened the night Susan disappeared raised more questions than answers, and what began as an unsolved mystery spiraled into a custody battle, which tragically ended last Sunday with the horrific murder-suicide of Josh Powell and their two innocent sons, Charles, 7, and Braden, 5.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.

programme.title: BarryTiger

Con una variedad de personajes coloridos y temas ricos y diversos, la serie muestra los momentos alegres de la vida de la familia BarryTiger. La producción musical de alta calidad, con melodías excepcionales, arreglos sobresalientes y actuaciones destacadas, añade una capa extra de diversión a las escenas animadas y dinámicas. ¡Prepárate para cantar, bailar y explorar junto a Barry y sus amigos en cada emocionante episodio!

programme.title: Domi Kids

Un equipo profesional de producción musical asegura melodías de primera calidad, arreglos excepcionales y actuaciones vocales destacadas, brindando un festín audiovisual encantador para los niños. El contenido es positivo, entretenido y está diseñado para ayudar a los niños a aprender y explorar el mundo de una manera apropiada para su edad. Además, apoya a los padres en su camino hacia una crianza fácil y placentera, mientras acompaña a los niños en su crecimiento y desarrollo."

programme.title: Papelitos
programme.desc: La serie animada “papelitos” cuenta de una manera divertida a los más pequeñitos sobre las simpáticas aventuras de unos animales de papel: Un alce llamado Aristóteles y un pájaro carpintero llamado Tuc-Tuc en el país de papel donde todo por completo está hecho de papel. Divertidas aventuras se acompañan con interesantes clases de manualidades donde los espectadores aprenderán como con papel y cartón crear a todos los personajes de la serie utilizando tijeras y pegamento. El proyecto tiene apoyo de la página web donde están presentados todos los moldes y consejos para crear el mundo de papel. De esta manera el espectador participa en el juego que supone la creación y el desarrollo de muchas habilidades prácticas que distraen a los chicos del encierro permanente de la computadora. El proyecto “Papelitos” es una divertida y didáctica alternativa en lugar de pasar tiempo con la computadora. Toda la acción en el dibujo animado es narrada por una voz en off y repleta de ingeniosos chistes. Cada capítulo dura 5 minutos (la versión sin clase – 4 minutos). La técnica de animación – gráficos 3D que imitan al papel.

programme.title: BFF

Sus aventuras están llenas de momentos musicales y situaciones desternillantes interrumpidas constantemente por Shadow, un personaje mágico y travieso que intenta difundir desesperadamente negatividad y “malas vibraciones”. Sin embargo, ¡sus intentos se verán frustrados por las BFF y sus collares de la amistad!

programme.title: Glumpers
programme.desc: Si la simple convivencia entre dos personas puede hacer que salten chispas, imagínense lo que podría suceder en una casa habitada por seres con 6 personalidades completamente opuestas. Los Glumpers son una pandilla, un grupo de amigos que viven juntos, las acusadas personalidades de los cuales interactúan continuamente. Si entre los seres humanos una simple discusión en general, va a terminar con sólo un par de insultos, en el caso de los Glumpers puede terminar, en el mejor de los casos, en una explosión atómica.

programme.title: Alex y el Huerto
programme.desc: Cada mañana, la abuela le da una semilla mágica a Alex y él se apresura a la huerta para plantarla. Entonces, va a la fuente a por agua, por lo que puede regar las semillas mágicas. Alex espera con impaciencia para ver como la fruta o vegetal va a crecer. Luego, con destellos de magia, surge de una planta del suelo, y ahí está ... ... un naranjo! Va con una cesta y coge la fruta que van a comer para el almuerzo. Abuela y Alex se sientan a la mesa y comen la fruta o beben su jugo. En Al final, podemos ver y escuchar la explicación de las propiedades básicas de la fruta que acaban de comer.

programme.title: Boom and Reds

Trata sobre Boom, un cálido y amigable ogro violeta, el cual en cada episodio, intentara averiguar que estan dibujando en el suelo, los reds, una pequeña banda de criaturas de cabezas de champiñones. Desgraciadamente, el echo de que Boom no sea muy inteligente no le ayudará, haciendole pensar en locas sugerencias.
